about.title: About me
about.summary: Electronic Engineer and Software Developer with over 9 years of experience leading and building large-scale technological solutions for fintechs, digital banking, and e-commerce. Specialized in mobile ecosystems and frontend web architectures, with a strong focus on resilience, Clean Architecture, Feature Flags, metrics, vulnerability mitigation, and performance optimization.

experience.title: Experience
experience.subtitle: A timeline of my professional journey.

bullets: Led the technical release cycle with continuous deployments to production for core mobile and web digital banking solutions, ensuring secure transactions and high availability.
Implemented and orchestrated Feature Flags (Unleash) for progressive rollouts, massive segmentation, and A/B testing, enabling kill switches and zero-risk releases.
Designed and developed Backend-Driven UI (BDUI) architectures using Node.js BFFs to control Flutter layouts dynamically without requiring app store updates.
Built decentralized architectures, reusable components, and reactive design patterns.
Accelerated the delivery cycle and increased code coverage through AI-assisted workflows (Cursor), automating unit test generation and optimizing Pull Request analysis.
Developed a fintech platform for grain trading and settlement using React and TypeScript.
Built a mobile application with React Native focused on onboarding flows and identity validation for e-commerce.
Configured and maintained CI/CD build pipelines for Android (APK/AAB) and iOS (IPA), and resolved critical vulnerabilities identified during pentesting.
Led frontend teams in international fintech projects (MERN Stack) and US/Canada real estate platforms (MEVN Stack).
Architected internal libraries and design systems used by multiple development cells (Storybook).
Implemented rigorous unit testing (Vitest, Jest) and provided technical mentoring to junior and trainee developers.
Developed real-time web interfaces connected to industrial sensors for process variable measurement and control.
Integrated MongoDB databases and programmed microcontrollers coupled with electronic instrumentation.
